notes.title: Achievements
notes.content:
Achievements for killing bosses, special deaths and collecting hearts/skins
Player can now pickup unattached kunai
2 more songs by Brian O'Mahoney
Blob enemy voices
Progress panel displays hearts and skins
Prevent the leaderboard page buttons from going out of bounds
Settings menu tooltip descriptions
Challenge mode lighting
Adjust time required to earn stars for some levels (Generally easier)
Easier to escape the acid pit in level 3-4
Slightly more protection from bombs in 3-5

notes.title: New Skins + Cloud Save + Weekly Challenge
notes.content:
Add more skins and display when unlocked
 Cloud save
 Changed Daily Challenge to Weekly Challenge
 Increased goblin boss difficulty (again)
 Display grapple descriptions
 Fix challenge mode leaderboard bug
 Fix sound effects for flame pipes and goblin boss thruster fire
 Add sound when lever is triggered

notes.title: Daily Challenge Update
notes.content:
Challenge Mode
- Rename "RNG" to "Daily Challenge" and "Custom Challenge"
- Save custom random seed times (local only)
- More variety to random levels
- Add skin selector to menu
- Generate seed button
- Display leaderboard from menu
- Display challenge time remaining
- Minor bug fixes

Main Menu
- Minor visual updates
- Community menu in options with links to discord, social media and email
- Feedback menu in options
- Escape key clicks back button

Gameplay
- Skeleton king roar bug fixed to use volume settings in options
- Levels 1-9 and 1-11 slightly easier
- Reduce velocity loss when hitting water
- Drown faster

Sounds/Music
- New character voices by Dadbeard, MykroMayem and Bill White
- New chiptune music tracks by Brian O'Mahoney

notes.title: Daily RNG Level Challenge Patch
notes.content: You can now compete in a daily randomly generated level against others in the leaderboards. See the RNG Level in the world select menu. A new level/leaderboard is generated at midnight GMT time.

notes.title: Early Access Patch #3
notes.content:
Changed explosion visual size to match actual force and damage effect.
 Added New world unlocked Panel
 Added skip level panel
 Punching glove fix for 4-4
 Fix 8-12 performance issue
 General level tweaks
 4-12 boss tweak
 Fall damage minimum force for damage increased by 3%
